clauses.quoted_text:
4. Delivered Pricing
All prices are delivered duty paid (DDP) to Buyer's designated facility and are inclusive of all customs duties,
tariffs, brokerage, and import fees. Seller bears the risk of any change in such charges for the term of each
Order.
clauses.reasoning: Prices are delivered duty paid, so the customer never bore the tariff; nothing to pass back.
